definition_en: The ability to plan, allocate, and optimise resources—including time, money, materials, and people—to achieve operational efficiency and organisational goals.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk merancang, memperuntukkan dan mengoptimumkan sumber — masa, wang, bahan dan manusia — bagi mencapai kecekapan operasi dan matlamat organisasi.
typical_tasks_en:
• Schedule staff shifts for the retail store to cover peak hours without exceeding budget.
• Reorder stock based on predicted demand and warehouse capacity.
• Balance the event budget across venue, catering, and marketing.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Jadualkan syif kakitangan untuk kedai runcit bagi menampung waktu puncak tanpa melebihi bajet.
• Pesan semula stok berdasarkan permintaan diramal dan kapasiti gudang.
• Seimbangkan bajet acara merentasi venue, katering dan pemasaran.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires budgeting, scheduling, or allocating resources
• The task involves optimising processes for efficiency
• The task requires managing supply chains or logistics
• The task involves capacity planning or workload balancing
• The task requires tracking and controlling operational costs
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only executing work without planning resources
• The user performs tasks without any allocation or scheduling responsibility
• The task requires no consideration of cost, time, or material constraints
• The user follows a pre-set plan without managing the resources behind it
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the person executes work but makes no scheduling, budgeting, or allocation decision.

confusions.boundary_rule: Resource management allocates resources. Quality control checks outputs against standards.
confusions.example_task: Allocate budget for additional quality inspectors.
confusions.expected_labels: Resource management and operations; Quality control

confusions.boundary_rule: Resource management allocates people as resources. Talent management develops them.
confusions.example_task: Schedule staff across shifts while planning their training.
confusions.expected_labels: Resource management and operations; Talent management

confusions.boundary_rule: Resource management optimises allocation. Systems thinking sees broader interdependencies.
confusions.example_task: Balance staff, budget, and inventory to meet seasonal demand.
confusions.expected_labels: Resource management and operations; Systems thinking
